about.title: About Water Intake Calculator - Daily Hydration Needs
about.description: The Water Intake Calculator determines your daily hydration needs based on weight, activity level, and environmental factors. Proper hydration is essential for optimal body function, energy levels, and overall health. Water requirements vary based on individual factors like body size, physical activity, climate, and health conditions. This calculator provides personalized recommendations to help maintain optimal hydration throughout the day.

faq.q: How much water should I drink daily?
faq.a: Generally 8-10 glasses (2-2.5 liters) for adults, but this varies significantly based on weight, activity level, and climate. The calculator provides personalized recommendations ranging from 1.5-4+ liters depending on your individual factors.

faq.q: Does coffee and tea count toward water intake?
faq.a: Yes, caffeinated beverages contribute to hydration, though pure water is most effective for optimal hydration. Limit high-caffeine drinks as they can have mild diuretic effects, especially in large quantities.

faq.q: How do I know if I'm properly hydrated?
faq.a: Check urine color - pale yellow indicates good hydration, while dark yellow suggests dehydration. Also monitor thirst levels, energy, skin elasticity, and overall well-being as hydration indicators.

faq.q: Should I drink more water when exercising?
faq.a: Yes, significantly increase intake before, during, and after exercise. Add 12-16 oz for every hour of activity, more in hot conditions or intense workouts. Pre-hydrate 2-3 hours before exercise and continue hydrating post-workout.
